node.title: Token Attribution Ledger — every token to its outcome
node.summary: The ledger that ties every dollar of AI spend to the work it produced and the outcome it shipped — the substrate under Token Intelligence.
node.interview_question: What's in the ledger at the row level, and what stops it from being a prettier version of a cost report?

competitor.name: Exceeds AI
competitor.positioning: Exceeds AI does commit/line-level AI-vs-human diffing and is outcome-priced (<$20K/yr) — a cheaper, narrower attack on the same attribution claim.
